# Rebecca 1.7.0

Rebecca 1.7.0 adds an admin notifications center with automatic alerts, a paginated and searchable services page, a rebuilt mobile navigation, and inline admin and node details. It also makes node user updates more reliable and fixes several Xray and update-catalog issues.

## Highlights

- 🔔 **Notifications** — a notifications tab and header bell show admin notifications, and an alert worker records automatic alerts for events that need attention.
- 📋 **Services page** — the services table is paginated, searchable, and lists every service.
- 📱 **Mobile navigation** — the mobile tab bar is rebuilt and the header is polished.
- 🧭 **Inline details** — admin and node details expand inside their tables instead of opening a separate dialog.
- 🩺 **Node updates** — user changes run on their own five-second loop, batches are planned without reloading each node's configuration, and changes keep flowing while a node's full sync fails.
- 🧩 **Xray fixes** — live user updates send the correct Shadowsocks 2022 method and chacha20 client configs are corrected, and chacha20 Shadowsocks 2022 inbounds with multiple users are rejected with a clear error.
- 🔄 **Updates** — the update target is the newest listed release, and the last build catalog is kept when GitHub cannot be read.

## Reliability and compatibility

- Sponsor placements keep loading when the local sponsor cache cannot be read or written.
- The gateway accepts PROXY protocol headers only from trusted peers.
- The user dialog layout is tidied up.
- New documentation covers external apps, SSL, hosts, Xray, and monitoring.

## Upgrade notes

> Back up the database before updating. Rebecca 1.7.0 adds notification tables, which are created automatically when the panel starts. Upgrade Rebecca and Rebecca Node together.
